entries.0b9cabddfeefd18c: The holding company of an independent IT company group that provides system development and IT infrastructure and security services, mainly in the social infrastructure field.
entries.1c939fd1957e7fd9: This business develops business systems and control and embedded systems centered on social infrastructure fields, targeting the following areas: public sector (mutual aid, national health insurance, national pension, personnel and payroll), electric power (billing calculation and meter-reading systems), manufacturing (embedded systems for electronic component mounting equipment and semiconductor manufacturing equipment), telecommunications, finance, education, healthcare and mobility. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,796 million.
entries.2cc122bb102794d3: This business provides design and construction of IT infrastructure centered on cloud environments, implementation support and operations management, together with security services such as security diagnostics, CSIRT/SIRT operation support and penetration testing. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,081 million.
entries.31a2e197910c5e3d: This is the single segment of the company group, providing system development, IT infrastructure construction and security services in an integrated manner, centered on social infrastructure fields (public sector, electric power, telecommunications, finance, etc.).
